pcs.pc_description: collect the refilled LPG cylinders from the godown as per the days distribution schedule and plan of delivery
collect sound cylinders from the godown after carrying out pre-delivery checks (weight, body leak, bung leak, seal, etc.)
ensure the tool kit is ready with all the essential tools and replenish the required consumables
collect the cash memos/POS machines/mobiles/any other delivery documents from the godown/showroom and carry them along for delivery
ensure all the requisite details are printed on the cash memo
carry a portable weighing machine to check the weight of the cylinder
keep the delivery vehicle ready
check the consumer's address and delivery time instructions
in case the house is found locked, stick the tear-off slip with house-lock intimation on the consumers main door. Alternatively, update the Ezy Gas App with refill returns and reason for the returns
greet the consumer
weigh the cylinder in the presence of the consumer to verify weight as per standards
roll the cylinder on foot ring to the kitchen
ensure there are no other inflammable items in the kitchen and no open flames during delivery and checking of new refill
switch off the knob of the gas stove and also the regulator
conduct a Pre-Delivery Check (PDC)
replace the empty cylinder with a new refill
in case of new connection follow the SOP for new connection installation
check the pressure regulator and rubber hose while replacing the cylinder
open the seal, connect the regulator with the cylinder and ensure that the regulator fits the cylinder properly
check for any leakage in the cylinder (from the joint and valve)
switch on the regulator
light a matchstick
switch on the gas stove to make sure that flame is ignited
remove the regulator, put on the safety cap on the valve of the cylinder, mark the cylinder as faulty and send it back to the godown in case of any leakage
check in case of faulty O-ring, replace it
in case of new connection, demonstrate the use with a live demo
explain safety instructions to the consumer about using the LPG cylinder
provide the cash memo to the consumer, collect the cost in cash, card, e-wallet or other appropriate mode and return the balance amount (if any) in case of cash payment
obtain the consumers signature on the counter slip and retain the copy
update the serial number, date of delivery in the consumers book and complete the transaction on Ezy Gas App
politely communicate to the consumer against unsafe practices
inform the consumer about available schemes/ARB products, important/emergency numbers
ask the consumer for feedback, record the same and convey the same to the showroom staff
if the consumer has a single cylinder, suggest them to go for double cylinder, to ensure that he/she has uninterrupted supply of LPG
thank the consumer before leaving
return the cash memo counter slip copy to showroom
inform the distributor about any unsafe practices observed at the consumers premises (e.g. using LPG stove on the floor, using the green rubber hose, using T joint for connecting two burners, etc.)
